title: Fix Playground Showing Default Example When None Selected
description: The playground/example dropdown in the React OS shell (framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx) always forces the first registered example as the active example, even when no example was ever explicitly selected. The reconciliation useEffect at os-shell.tsx around activeExampleId cannot distinguish "no selection yet" (empty string) from "stale/removed selection", so it always falls back to exampleOptions[0]. Fix so that when no example is selected, the playground shows an empty/blank state (leveraging the existing NAVBAR_NO_EXAMPLE_ID sentinel in ui/js/react/index.tsx) instead of silently loading the default example, and remove the unused/duplicate NAVBAR_NO_EXAMPLE_ID constant in os-shell.tsx.
